root_cause.text: The function `need_this_block()` in the RAID5 stripe handling code did not check whether the llbitmap blocks are synced (`bitmap_ops->blocks_synced()`), so when the bitmap bit was unwritten, it failed to force RCW (reconstruct write) as required, causing the stripe handler to deadloop because `handle_stripe_fill()` was used but `need_this_block()` always returned false, leaving the stripe unprocessed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check for `mddev->bitmap_ops && mddev->bitmap_ops->blocks_synced && !mddev->bitmap_ops->blocks_synced(mddev, sh->sector)` to `need_this_block()`, alongside the existing `rmw_level` check; the CVE description states that the same check is present in `handle_stripe_dirtying()` but missing in `need_this_block()`, leading to the hang.
